capabilities: create Markdown files with sequential numbered filenames
configure per-folder prefixes, start numbers and digit counts
reuse missing numbers in a sequence before assigning the next
create and open files from the command palette
extras: README states mobile support has not been verified and targets desktop only; includes a Chinese-language description of use cases and a community plugin submission checklist.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to create notes with auto-incrementing sequential filenames tied to specific folders.
summary: Creates Markdown files with sequential numbered filenames like GS0001 or RY0001, per configured folder and prefix.
